firstPlayerRule: Choose or randomly assign the factions. The Woodwalker Chieftain goes first whenever a phase step requires turn order; the Ironclad Commander goes second.
clarifications: In the Action Phase, the Woodwalker acts first, then players alternate until each has played three cards.
The same faction order applies in later rounds, including removing ongoing-card markers and recruiting Fighters when those steps require turn order.
This entry covers the two-player setup. The two solo opponents have separate setup and round-summary rules.
